instruction: Make an order for two same-colored Hanes Men's ComfortSoft Short Sleeve T-Shirt in extra-large size on Amazon. My color preference is, red > black > navy blue. Pick the most preferred color that is available.
notes: Color availability is only known at runtime, so the target product is modeled as a single object standing for 'the extra-large variant in the most preferred in-stock color'; amazon-search-products (filtered by query and relative_size) discovers its id and amazon-show-product verifies the variant (stock/color/size) before it is added to the cart. The color objects and the static more-preferred facts document the preference order red > black > navy blue but do not constrain planning. add_product_to_cart is called with quantity=2 and clear_cart_first=true so the resulting order contains exactly one order item with quantity 2 (cart changes are ignored by the evaluation). The existing default address and payment card are looked up (never modified) and used for place_order. supervisor-complete-task takes the ordered product/quantity as task-record parameters (not API arguments) so its precondition equals the goal; it is the last action and the only source of (task-completed).
